info.title: Atoll Encrypted Chat API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the Atoll server API. Derived from code annotations. Source of truth remains Server Spec v3.0.4.

post.description: Revokes current session (or all sessions if all_sessions is true) (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

get.description: Server capabilities and configuration advertisement endpoint (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.1).
Server liveness check endpoint (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.1).
Server readiness check endpoint verifying DB, OPRF key, and Sockudo (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.1).

post.description: Queries a user by their one-way derived lookup token (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.3).

400.description: Bad request / missing or invalid token

get.description: Fetches the current authenticated user's profile and limits (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.1).

delete.description: Anonymizes and soft-deletes the current user's account and associated data (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2). Requires fresh session and confirmation.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's encrypted display name and/or profile payload (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.2).

400.description: Bad request / invalid payload or immutable field

post.description: Uploads a user avatar image as a multipart/form-data payload (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.7).

requestBody.description: Multipart avatar file and manifest metadata

400.description: Bad request / missing file or invalid manifest

get.description: Lists all registered devices for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

delete.description: Revokes a registered device for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

patch.description: Updates the encrypted name for a target device owned by the user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.8).

400.description: Bad request / missing or invalid encrypted name

get.description: Generates and streams a ZIP archive containing the user's exported data (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §14.3).
Retrieves an encrypted preference value by key (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.8).

404.description: Preference not found or reserved key

delete.description: Deletes an encrypted preference by key (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.8).

400.description: Invalid key syntax or reserved key

patch.description: Sets or updates an encrypted preference value (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.8).

400.description: Invalid key, invalid value, or reserved key

get.description: Lists all active push subscriptions for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

post.description: Registers or updates a push notification subscription for the user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

delete.description: Revokes a specific push subscription for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

post.description: Updates the user's read state cursor for a specified room (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.5).

400.description: Bad request / missing field or invalid message ID

patch.description: Updates the ordered list of room IDs for sidebar display (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.6).

403.description: Not a member of one or more specified rooms

get.description: Lists all active session tokens for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

delete.description: Revokes a specific session token for the current user (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2).

get.description: Lists starred items with optional type, room, limit, and cursor filtering (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.9).

400.description: Invalid item type or invalid cursor

post.description: Stars a message, attachment, or link item (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.9).

404.description: Room or starred item not found

delete.description: Removes a star from an item (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.9).

get.description: Fetches user-scoped state updates since a given sequence cursor (Server Spec v3.0.4 §8.2, §8.2.4).
